user.title: API 4 Czech Cars (public API)
user.description: Create an API key in the MyŠkoda app and select your vehicle there.

reauth_confirm.title: API key expired
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new API key from the MyŠkoda app.

error.invalid_auth: API key is invalid, expired, or not authorized for this VIN.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Škoda API.

data.ac_without_external_power: Allow air conditioning without external power

init.description: Remote commands operate a real vehicle. Enable A/C without external power only when safe. The API allows about 20 requests/hour; commands trigger another refresh.

request.name: Send API request
request.description: Send a raw request to /api/v1/vehicles/{vin}{path}, e.g. a remote command from the API reference.

vin.name: VIN
vin.description: Needed only with more than one vehicle.

refresh.name: Refresh afterwards
refresh.description: Poll the vehicle state after the request (uses quota).
